events.title: HOUSE OF THE DEVIL (2009)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**The House of the Devil**
2009 - 1hr 33mins
Horror/Suspense

In 1983, financially struggling college student Samantha Hughes takes a strange babysitting job that coincides with a full lunar eclipse. She slowly realizes her clients harbor a terrifying secret, putting her life in mortal danger.

events.title: LATE NIGHT DOUBLE FEATURE: Autopsy of Jane Doe (2016) and MARQUIS (1989)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come hang out and watch a late night double feature.

**Warning! Marquis is a little "risque" so please google it ahead of time if you want to make sure you will not be offended!** There are puppets/animatronics and lots and lots of LUST. This is a fun interpretation of the imprisonment of the Marquis de Sade with a French revolution framework.

**9pm: AUTOPSY OF JANE DOE**
2016 - 1hr 26mins
Horror/Mystery
After a massacre, Sheriff Burke delivers an unidentified body to Tommy Tilden and Austin Tilden. As they perform an autopsy, impossible discoveries emerge. Each new finding deepens a mystery that threatens their survival.

**10:30: MARQUIS**
1989 - 1hr 23mins
Satire/Comedy/Drama
**Language:** French w/ English subtitles
Pre-French Revolution Bastille holds political prisoners: a woman impregnated by king after rape, police chief accused of selling tainted meat, Marquis wrongfully charged with conspiring against king.

events.title: TERROR TELE-THON on 16mm presented by Exhumed Films and The Colonial Theatre
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
On Sunday, Nov. 22, Exhumed Films presents the TERROR TELE-THON at the Colonial Theatre!

Join us—if you dare!—for a tele-fright festival featuring four gorgeous original 16mm broadcast prints, screening just as they shocked audiences on the air when they originally played on the small screen!

Turn out and tune in for an afternoon of vintage tv scares on the big screen, projected from flickering film! The line up will remain a mystery but we guarantee a wicked mix of favorites, obscure gems, and rare television terror you may never have seen before!

The show will also include a mix of horror tv spots, spooky commercials and rare television shows between the features!

You do NOT want to miss this show!

**Showtime**: Doors open at 1:00 PM, Marathon begins at 2:00 PM.

**Location**: Colonial Theatre, White Rabbit Theatre, 227 Bridge Street. Phoenixville, PA 19460

Tickets are $28 for General Admission (+ $4 fees).
